content.name: Healer's Kit
entries: This kit is a leather pouch containing bandages, salves, and splints. The kit has ten uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 hit points, without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

content.name: Healer's Kit
entries: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|SRD52}) check.
